messages:
Erin: Quick kickoff: Skyline Marketplace joint launch w/ FastCache. Scope = one marketplace listing, one co-authored how-to, and a 30m webinar. Target week: Aug 12.

Vik: Recommend we lead with a developer-first how-to: "deploy inference + caching in under 15 minutes". Audience: infra engineers.

Chen: Partner will provide sanitized perf deltas and an architecture SVG. Legal requires percent-only claims. Can we show percent bar charts + appendix repo?

Rosa: I'll own creative and screenshots. Need demo access Thu to capture flows. Preferred sizes: hero 1200x600, screenshot 560x315.

Erin: Tracking: registration -> HubSpot. UTM to standardize: `?utm_source=fastcache&utm_medium=partner_webinar&utm_campaign=fc-sky-aug12`. Please use exact string.

Vik: Webinar agenda: 5m intros, 12m demo, 8m benchmark highlights, 5m partner perspective. Keep slides <7.

Chen: Publishables: 1) gated how-to repo, 2) short benchmark blog, 3) marketplace blurb. We'll place reproducible steps in the repo.

LeadBot: Form created: https://forms.redwood/fc-sky-aug12. Recording auto-upload to gdrive/marketing/partners/fc-sky-0812.

Rosa: I'll post creative checklist here once I have demo creds. Also will add a headshot slot for partner speaker.

Erin: Routing: SFDC queue "Partners/FastCache". If email domain ends with @fastcache.dev assign to partner AE. Tag leads with lead_source=partner_webinar.

Vik: KPI targets: 400 regs, 90 live, 25 MQLs. Follow-up email to include repo link and integration guide.

Chen: Action items: Rosa (creative + screenshots due Tue), Vik (slides + runbook Fri), Erin (HubSpot form + SFDC mapping Wed), Chen (partner asset sign-off Fri). Quick sync Thurs 10am PT.

Erin: thanks team 75; ping me for blockers.
